details:
ASTRALIS — Your Gateway to the Stars

Project Overview

ASTRALIS is a web-based astronomy learning platform developed to make exploring the universe more accessible, interactive, and engaging.

Built with Python and the Django framework, ASTRALIS combines scientific information, interactive web technologies, and astronomy-focused educational resources in one platform.

Main Features

1. Astronomy Encyclopedia

An organized collection of astronomical information that helps users discover celestial objects and learn about the universe.

2. Explore Section

A searchable environment that allows users to explore different celestial objects and access relevant astronomical information.

3. Observatory

A dedicated section designed to bring astronomical information and exploration tools together.

4. 3D Solar System

An interactive 3D experience that introduces users to the solar system and its celestial bodies.

5. NASA-Related Information

The platform includes astronomy-related information and NASA resources to help users connect educational content with real space science.

6. User Accounts and Favorites

User-oriented features that support a more personalized experience and allow users to interact with the platform.

Technology

The project was developed using:

  • Python
  • Django
  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JavaScript
  • SQLite

Innovation and Impact

ASTRALIS aims to connect software development with scientific education. Instead of presenting astronomy as a collection of disconnected facts, it provides an organized digital environment where users can explore, search, and interact with astronomical content.

The intended impact is to encourage interest in astronomy, improve access to space science education, and inspire the next generation of space enthusiasts, scientists, and explorers.

ASTRALIS represents an effort to make the universe easier to explore through technology.
